Counterpoint Research today published a report pointing out that Apple once again occupied five spots among the world's top ten best-selling smartphones in the second quarter of 2026. Below are the details.

MagSafe and higher storage capacity help iPhone 17e break into the top ten

Over the past few months, numerous reports have indicated that the iPhone 17 series has been selling well, particularly as most of Apple's major competitors raised prices due to ongoing component shortages.

Counterpoint published three reports a few days ago showing that Apple has bucked the trend across multiple markets, recording growth in both shipments and sales.

The firm published its latest report today, stating that the iPhone 17 became the world's best-selling smartphone in the second quarter of 2026, accounting for 6% of global smartphone sales.

Apple also secured second and third place with the iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPhone 17 Pro respectively, while the iPhone 17e ranked seventh and the iPhone 16 came in tenth. The latter had topped the chart during the same period last year with a 4% market share.

Samsung is the only other manufacturer to make it into the top ten, with the Galaxy S26 Ultra 5G in fourth place, the Galaxy A07 4G in fifth, the Galaxy A17 5G in sixth, the Galaxy A17 4G in eighth, and the Galaxy S26 5G in ninth.

Counterpoint also pointed out that the top ten best-selling smartphones collectively accounted for 26% of overall sales, an increase of 2 percentage points compared to the same period last year.
